name: Skater Hops

instructions.description: Stand on one leg with the opposite foot lightly off the floor and your trunk slightly hinged.
Push sideways to hop onto the other leg, landing softly with the knee bent.
Let the trailing leg move behind the body for counterbalance without twisting the knee.
Continue alternating side to side with controlled, athletic landings.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use time-based intervals with quality landings.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Step side to side instead of hopping to reduce impact.

commentsNotes: Focus on stable landings before adding speed.
Keep the knee aligned with the foot on each landing.
